item.title: Version 1.2.25 (Build 20260828)
item.description:
What's New

fix(smart-switch): keep excluded apps out of Smart Switch

The excluded-app check only ran in the per-keystroke path, so an app on the

exclusion list still took part in Smart Switch: activating it restored its

saved language and flipped the menu bar to V, and the state it recorded then

leaked to the next app that had no saved entry of its own.

Move the passthrough and user-list logic into isAppExcluded(bundleIdentifier:)

— dead until now — so it also honours the exclusionRulesEnabled master switch,

and have isCurrentAppExcluded() delegate to it after its overlay exemption.

The tap path behaves exactly as before; the Smart Switch paths now share the

same predicate and skip excluded apps when restoring on app switch, when an

input source change arrives, when an overlay is dismissed, and when the user

toggles E/V by hand.

Overlay apps (Spotlight, Raycast, Alfred) are never excluded by design, so

their Smart Switch sites are left untouched.

Fixes #321
